dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, high-contrast light-gray perimeters surrounding dark circular centers; edges exhibit a sharp step-gradient from light to dark; visible in a cluster of approximately 5-7 distinct 'O' and 'C' shapes on the upper-mid flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of localized, high-intensity light-gray pixel clusters concentrated on the anterior-dorsal region, with density decreasing significantly toward the posterior third of the visible body.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli on the mid-dorsal axis form an irregular quadrilateral; these are linked to surrounding high-intensity blobs forming a series of adjacent, non-uniform triangles.
